posts.name: cmaelstrom
posts.cooked: So, there have been a couple episodes of the Letters Page where either Christopher or Adam said something and then mentioned that they would get that quote on a cross stich. I've got a couple of them written down, but I know that I am missing at least one of them (the first one, something about controlling the world, but I don't remember the exact words). I have "The blood carries the life" and "We make things up and then are surprised when you like them." I don't remember which episodes they are specifically said in, and rather than fishing and hoping, I figured I would check to see if anyone could help me out with remembering them. Thanks a bunch!
